benchmarks.name: AutomationBench
benchmarks.what_it_measures: End-to-end multi-app workflow completion across browser, desktop, and file system.
benchmarks.what_the_difference_means: The system moves from needing human intervention every 3 steps to completing 20+ step workflows unattended.

benchmarks.name: ScreenSpot Pro
benchmarks.what_it_measures: Precise identification and pixel-coordinate clicking on obscure UI elements, submenus, and canvas objects.
benchmarks.what_the_difference_means: Reduces mis-clicks on complex web apps and desktop software, drastically cutting navigation deadlocks.

benchmarks.name: TerminalBench
benchmarks.what_it_measures: Multi-step bash execution, pipe construction, error-handling, and Linux environment administration.
benchmarks.what_the_difference_means: Capable of diagnosing package dependency conflicts and running build systems without human prompting.

benchmarks.name: Agents Last Exam
benchmarks.what_it_measures: Hard multimodal research problems requiring web search, code synthesis, mathematical derivation, and document synthesis.
benchmarks.what_the_difference_means: More than doubles the ability of an autonomous agent to solve graduate-level multidisciplinary research inquiries.

benchmarks.name: FrontierMath
benchmarks.what_it_measures: Unpublished, research-grade mathematics problems crafted by world-class mathematicians.
benchmarks.what_the_difference_means: First model to show substantial traction on original research math beyond contest mathematics.

benchmarks.name: ARC-AGI
benchmarks.what_it_measures: Abstract visual logic grids requiring immediate induction of rules never encountered during pretraining.
benchmarks.what_the_difference_means: High generalization on purely out-of-distribution abstract spatial reasoning.
